method: Agent visual interpretation of unlabelled RGB, CIR and LiDAR-height panels; approximate crown ellipses, never surveyed stems. Pixel coordinates refer to the CHM PNG at four pixels per metre. No detector results were used to place annotations.
limits: Ellipse outlines are approximate visual crown extents.
Different acquisition years and orthophoto relief displacement prevent surveyed-stem accuracy claims.
Unresolved woodland interiors, edge-clipped crowns and small vegetation are excluded from scoring.
Reference sample is purposive, not a statistically representative inventory of the whole course.
